title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 37
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 37: Hezekiah prays, Isaiah announces Yahweh's answer, and the angel strikes the Assyrian camp.

questions.text: What did king Hezekiah do when he heard the words of Rabshakeh?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh's house.

answers.text: He fled from the city to seek help from Egypt
He tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and went into Yahweh's house
He sent silver and gold as tribute to the king of Assyria
He gathered all his fighting men at the gate of the city

questions.text: To whom did Hezekiah send Eliakim, Shebna and the elders of the priests?
questions.explanation: He sent them, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

answers.text: Jeremiah the prophet, the son of Hilkiah
Tirhakah the king of Ethiopia
The elders of the city of Lachish
Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz

questions.text: What picture did Hezekiah's message use to describe that day of trouble?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah said that the children had come to the birth, and there was no strength to give birth.

answers.text: Children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth
A vineyard stripped bare of all its grapes at harvest
A ship broken to pieces on the rocks of the sea
A city left without walls, without gates and without bars

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would do to the king of Assyria?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would put a spirit in him, so that he would hear news and return to his own land, where he would fall by the sword.

answers.text: Strike him with blindness before the walls of Jerusalem
Deliver him alive into the hand of king Hezekiah
Put a spirit in him so he would hear news and return to his own land
Send a deadly famine into the middle of his camp

questions.text: Which king of Ethiopia was reported to have come out to fight against Assyria?
questions.explanation: The king of Assyria heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, that he had come out to fight against him.

answers.text: Sennacherib
Tirhakah
Esar Haddon
Baladan

questions.text: What did Hezekiah do with the letter he received from the messengers?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah read the letter, went up to Yahweh's house, and spread it before Yahweh.

answers.text: He spread it before Yahweh in Yahweh's house
He tore it to pieces before the messengers
He sent it back to Assyria unanswered
He burned it in front of all the people

questions.text: In his prayer, what did Hezekiah say the gods of the destroyed nations really were?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah said they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone, and therefore they were destroyed.

answers.text: The spirits of the dead kings of the nations
Angels who had rebelled and fallen from heaven
Idols overlaid with silver and with ivory
No gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would put in the nose of the king of Assyria?
questions.explanation: Because of his raging and arrogance, Yahweh said he would put his hook in his nose and his bridle in his lips, and turn him back the way he came.

answers.text: A ring of gold
A chain of iron
His hook
A cord of flax

questions.text: How many men in the Assyrian camp did Yahweh's angel strike?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians.

answers.text: One hundred and eighty-five thousand
One hundred and twenty thousand
Two hundred and eighty-five thousand
One hundred and sixty-five thousand

questions.text: Who struck Sennacherib with the sword as he worshiped in the house of Nisroch?
questions.explanation: His sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword and escaped into the land of Ararat.

answers.text: His chief servant Rabshakeh
The soldiers of Tirhakah of Ethiopia
His son and heir Esar Haddon
His sons Adrammelech and Sharezer
